title: On the internal modes of the ground state for 3D cubic--quintic equations
summary: Motivated by the problem of asymptotic stability for ground states of the Klein--Gordon and Schrödinger equations in three spatial dimensions in the presence of internal modes, we study the corresponding models with cubic--quintic nonlinearities. These equations arise in several physical contexts; in particular, the cubic--quintic Klein--Gordon equation appears naturally in the study of spin-$0$ particles in quantum field theory.
